"""Small text helpers."""


def count_lines(s):
    """Return the number of lines in s."""
    return len(s.splitlines())


def last_n_lines(s, n):
    """Return the last n lines of s, oldest first."""
    lines = s.splitlines()
    return lines[len(lines) - n - 1:]
